result.description:
Membership and Systems Manager

Permanent part-time | 15 hours per week | Hybrid | Edgecliff, Sydney

PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy is recruiting a Membership and Systems Manager for a respected, long-established medical membership organisation based in Edgecliff.

This is a permanent part-time opportunity offering approximately 15 hours per week. The role will combine membership administration, member engagement, database and CRM management, reporting, operational coordination and support for the organisation’s systems transition.

About the role

The Membership and Systems Manager will support the effective delivery of membership services while maintaining accurate systems, records and reporting.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing membership enquiries and providing responsive member support
Maintaining accurate membership records and database information
Supporting membership applications, renewals and related administration
Producing membership reports and monitoring data quality
Coordinating member communications and engagement activities
Supporting the implementation and ongoing use of the organisation’s membership management system
Assisting with data migration, validation, reconciliation and process documentation
Liaising with internal stakeholders and external software or service providers
Identifying opportunities to improve membership and administrative processes
Providing general operational and administrative support as required
About you

You may currently work in a professional association, membership organisation, not-for-profit, medical college, education provider or another member-focused environment.

You will ideally bring:

Experience in membership services, association administration or customer service
Experience using a membership database, CRM or Association Management System
Strong data accuracy, reporting and record-management skills
Confidence communicating with members and senior stakeholders
Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently
Experience supporting a system implementation or data migration would be highly regarded
Experience with Microsoft Upbeat CRM would be particularly advantageous

This opportunity may suit an experienced professional seeking meaningful part-time work, balancing other professional or personal commitments, building a portfolio career or returning to the workforce.

Working arrangement
Permanent part-time employment
Approximately 15 hours per week
Usually worked across two days
Hybrid working arrangement
At least one day per week in the Edgecliff office is preferred
Salary

The salary range is:

$90,000–$105,000 per annum plus superannuation on a full-time equivalent basis.

As this role is approximately 0.4 FTE, the actual pro-rated salary is approximately:

$36,000–$42,000 per annum plus superannuation.

This equates to approximately $46–$54 per hour, depending on the final salary offered.

Eligibility

Applicants must have valid Australian working rights. Candidates holding temporary visas may be considered, subject to verification of their individual visa conditions and ongoing ability to perform the required hours.
How to apply

Please apply through Workforce Australia and include an up-to-date CV outlining your relevant membership, CRM, database, reporting and stakeholder-engagement experience.

For a confidential discussion, contact:

Pri Menon Gillett
Founder and Managing Director
PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy Pty Ltd
Email: pri@primarecruitmentandconsultancy.com.au
PRIMA welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including professionals returning to the workforce.

Software Developer
Mansys Pty Ltd is recruiting on behalf of Sonar Technologies International
Location: Macquarie Park, NSW
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience
About the Company
Sonar Technologies International is an Australian technology company specialising in enterprise mobility and smart business solutions.
Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.
About the Role
The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.
Key Responsibilities
•	Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.
•	Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.
•	Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.
•	Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.
•	Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.
•	Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.
•	Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.
•	Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.
•	Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.
•	Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.
•	Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.
•	Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.
•	Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.
•	Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.
Qualifications and Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.
•	Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.
•	Experience with REST APIs and system integration.
•	Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
•	Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.
Desirable Skills
•	Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.
•	Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.
•	Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.
•	Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.
•	Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Categories: Administration, Business and Management




 

Riverland Mallee Coorong Local Health Network, location negotiable

ASO3 | Administrative Services Officer Level 3 | $74,095.00 p.a. to $78,694.00 p.a.

Full time | Term Contract (temporary up to 10 March 2028)

Eligibility: Open to Everyone

About the Role:

Join the Riverland Mallee Coorong Community Health team as a CME Administrator and play a vital role in supporting quality healthcare across the region. In this rewarding position, you'll manage client information and medical records, provide accurate reporting, and help ensure community health services run efficiently making a meaningful contribution to the health and wellbeing of local communities every day.

What We're Looking For:

Essential Criteria 

Strong administrative, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Experience using and troubleshooting client management-database systems, including training others.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the preparation of reports, data analysis and statistical reporting.

Experience in records management with strong attention to detail and sound judgement.

Ability to solve problems, adapt to change and work effectively with diverse people and stakeholders.

Desired Criteria 

Experience developing policies and procedures, with strong leadership, training and document management skills.

Knowledge of community health services, database systems, reporting tools and records management standards.

Experience in quality improvement, accreditation and working within a health-related environment.

About Us

The Riverland Mallee Coorong Local Health Network, called RMCLHN for short, supports more than 70,000 people living in country South Australia in the towns and surrounds of Renmark, Paringa, Berri, Barmera, Waikerie, Loxton, Pinnaroo, Lameroo, Karoonda, Mannum, Murray Bridge, Tailem Bend, Meningie, Tintinara and Coonalpyn. Click here for more information about working for RMCLHN.

We will provide support, both personally and professionally giving you access to a range of education and training opportunities designed to enhance your role.

Offer flexible work arrangements to better balance work, personal life, and family commitments.

Provide an inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, ensuring every employee feels a sense of belonging and safety.

Offer salary sacrifice benefits, watch a short video about what salary packaging is.

Provide Relocation Support, where applicable. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support

Join RMCLHN's Corporate and Administration Professionals Team (video)

Applicant Information

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants are encouraged to apply.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category B

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

result.description:
About Us
Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership, and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as a leader in its field since 2006. We are a global technology enterprise focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environments with a strong presence in IT consulting and services.

Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153. You may be required to work at client sites (multiple locations possible), while remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner.

Type of position: Permanent, ongoing

Minimum Qualification: Any bachelor’s degree in computing or related field

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years

Job Description – Software Engineer
As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software applications and solutions. The role involves working with stakeholders to understand requirements, developing scalable and efficient systems, and ensuring applications meet performance and quality standards.

Detailed Job Description

Primary/Mandatory Skills:
•	Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software engineering
•	Strong programming skills in Java / .NET / Python
•	Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
•	Good knowledge of APIs, microservices, and web applications
•	Solid experience with relational databases (Oracle/SQL/MySQL)
•	Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies

Skillset Required:
•	Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs
•	Database design and optimization
•	Exposure to containerization and CI/CD tools (Docker, Jenkins, Git)
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Good to Have:
•	Experience with DevOps practices and Terraform
•	Knowledge of security best practices and system integration

Roles and Responsibilities:
•	Develop, build, review, and test front-end and back-end software solutions
•	Collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver high-quality outcomes
•	Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and optimization of applications
•	Prepare technical documentation and contribute to system design

Salary: $100k to $150k plus super

Next Steps
If this role matches your skills and career aspirations, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply directly with Resource Corner.
